title: China releases AI safety governance framework (DLA Piper, Sept 12, 2024)
notes: DLA Piper (recognized global law firm), full analysis. TC260 released AI Safety Governance Framework 2024-09-09 to implement Global AI Governance Initiative. People-centered, AI-for-good. Risk taxonomy: inherent (models/algorithms, data, systems) vs application (cyberspace, real-world, cognitive, ethical). Unlike EU AI Act 4 risk levels, Framework categorizes risk types not levels; EU model cited as future proposal (threshold-based pre-market approval). Sensitive nuclear/bio/chem/missile data banned from training; important data must not leave China. Tiered/category-based management, traceability, supply-chain security, emergency response.
